title: Computer Science Fundamentals
audience: Beginners; no programming or university mathematics assumed
template: AI tutorial visual styles and page behaviour
project: A small library catalogue; use separate examples where appropriate
stages: Develop and validate Modules 02–14 in order

title: What is computation?
什么是计算？
topics: Problems, algorithms, abstraction, input/output and the layers of a computer. Trace a search, test its contract and count its work.
问题、算法、抽象、输入输出和计算机的层次。跟踪搜索过程，验证约定，并统计操作次数。

title: Representing information
信息表示
topics: Binary, hexadecimal, integers, floating point and text encoding. Build a converter and explore rounding.
二进制、十六进制、整数、浮点数和文本编码。编写转换器，探索舍入误差。

title: Programming foundations
程序设计基础
topics: Variables, expressions, control flow, functions and debugging. Build a command-line catalogue.
变量、表达式、控制流、函数和调试。构建命令行图书目录。

title: Mathematical foundations
数学基础
topics: Logic, sets, relations, functions, proofs, induction and probability. Work with truth tables and simple proofs.
逻辑、集合、关系、函数、证明、归纳法和概率。练习真值表与简单证明。

title: Algorithms and efficiency
算法与效率
topics: Correctness, invariants, time and space complexity, Big O, searching and sorting.
正确性、不变式、时间与空间复杂度、大 O 表示法、搜索与排序。

title: Core data structures
核心数据结构
topics: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues and hash tables. Implement structures and compare their tradeoffs.
数组、链表、栈、队列和哈希表。实现数据结构，比较各自的取舍。

title: Recursion, trees and graphs
递归、树与图
topics: Call stacks, tree traversal, BFS, DFS and shortest paths. Build a route finder.
调用栈、树的遍历、广度优先搜索、深度优先搜索和最短路径。构建路径查询程序。

title: Algorithm design
算法设计
topics: Divide and conquer, greedy methods, backtracking and dynamic programming. Solve a scheduling problem.
分治、贪心、回溯和动态规划。解决调度问题。

title: Computer architecture
计算机体系结构
topics: Boolean gates, CPU instructions, memory, caches and execution. Trace a simulated machine.
逻辑门、CPU 指令、内存、缓存和执行过程。跟踪模拟机器的运行。

title: Operating systems
操作系统
topics: Processes, threads, scheduling, virtual memory, files and concurrency. Explore a race condition.
进程、线程、调度、虚拟内存、文件和并发。探索竞态条件。

title: Networks and the web
网络与 Web
topics: Layers, packets, addressing, DNS, TCP and HTTP. Build a local client and server.
网络分层、数据包、地址、DNS、TCP 和 HTTP。构建本地客户端与服务器。

title: Databases
数据库
topics: Relational modelling, SQL, keys, indexes and transactions. Persist the catalogue with SQLite.
关系建模、SQL、键、索引和事务。使用 SQLite 保存图书目录。

title: Languages and limits of computation
语言与计算的边界
topics: Parsing, interpreters, automata, computability, undecidability and P versus NP. Build an expression interpreter.
解析、解释器、自动机、可计算性、不可判定性和 P 与 NP。构建表达式解释器。

title: Software, security and integration
软件、安全与综合实践
topics: Testing, modularity, trust boundaries, validation and authentication. Complete the catalogue capstone.
测试、模块化、信任边界、输入验证和身份认证。完成图书目录综合项目。
